name: Ideals Are Poison: a clue counts once, stays in place without its sparkle, and resets when the quest is abandoned
contract: Quest 175035 needs 5 credits of Clues found 164511 from the clue objects 2300646-2300650 (type 10 goobers tied
to the quest). go_coa_ideals_are_poison_clue records each investigated clue per character. Expected: the Blood
Splatter counts once, then stays in the character's world but is no longer active for the quest, so it neither
sparkles nor counts again, also after the 15 s it used to respawn in. Abandoning and retaking the quest makes it
active again. The case joins world phase 1 to use spawn 9992004.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the clues are spawned
Let the clue reach the client

and is no longer active for the quest
the clue stays in the character's world
a second use does not count
Investigate it on the new attempt
